text:
Maria: quick smoke on m-13b-q4 with the new RoPE attenuation schedule. seeing consistent drift around ~8200 tokens, outputs become repetitive and hallucinate facts :thinking_face:
Alex: can you paste the exact config you used? and which quant build (int4v1/int4v2/int8)?
Maria: using int4v2 build from yesterday. config below:
```
model: m-13b-q4
quant: int4v2
rope:
  mode: attenuation
  schedule: linear
  start: 2048
  end: 16384
  factor: 0.78
server: dedicated-gpu-t4-8
batch: 1
cache: kv-enabled
```
Sam: thanks. did you run with prefix caching on? that can magnify rope issues on large windows.
Maria: prefix caching enabled (kv shards on). I also tried disabled cache: drift still appears but a bit delayed (~9600 tokens).
Alex: do we have a deterministic repro script? can you attach the prompt + seed?
Maria: pasted test prompt and seed below (shortened):
```
<BEGIN_PROMPT> longform explanation about distributed systems ... repeated anchor paragraph to reach tokens <END_PROMPT>
seed: 4082
```
Tim: I grabbed the kv-dump after 8200 tokens, noticed the rotary-phase vectors show amplitude attenuation followed by a sudden phase mismatch on shard 2. attaching quick diff:
```
kv_idx 8192 -> 8193: phase_delta_shard2 +0.48 (expected ~+0.002)
kv_idx 8193 -> 8194: norm_drop_shard2 -0.22
```
Eva: hmm that +0.48 looks like an accumulation bug when attenuation crosses the 'end' boundary in the schedule. maybe we forgot to rescale the phase basis when applying attenuation?
Alex: two hypotheses: (1) attenuation implementation multiplies rotary angles but doesn't renormalize on shard joins; (2) quantized kernel rounding introduces bias that accumulates at high positions.
Maria: I ran a control on float32 (no quant) with same schedule: smaller drift, but still visible after 12k tokens. so quant amplifies but isn't sole cause.
Sam: plan: 1) run without attenuation (baseline) 2) run with attenuation + forced renormalize step 3) run with attenuation but force int8 build to see quant effect. keep all else same.
Maria: kicked off jobs: baseline (2309876600), attn+renorm (2309876660), attn+int8 (2309876720). will paste logs as they finish.
Alex: also add a short test that steps the schedule boundary earlier (end=8192) to get faster repro.
Maria: updated job attn+renorm with end=8192 variant (2309876745).
Tim: quick note: if renormalize fixes phase_mismatch, we should still check perf impact. extra ops in the hot loop could add 5-12% latency.
Eva: agree. we can micro-opt the renorm to run only on shard-join events or when norm deviation > 0.05.
infra-bot: deploy complete: quant-build/int4v2-2026-03-19 pushed to canary nodes (canary pool id c-23).
Maria: attn+renorm (end=16384) finished: smaller phase deltas, hallucinations delayed to ~14500 tokens. improvement but not perfect.
Maria: attn+int8 finished: similar to int4v2 but slightly less drift magnitude.
Sam: sounds like attenuation math needs a subtle fix rather than just switching quant. can you capture kv snapshots at the moment of first large phase_delta for both int4 and float runs?
Maria: uploading kv snapshots to /redwood/tmp/2309876543/ with names kv-int4-8200.bin, kv-fp32-12000.bin, kv-int8-9000.bin
Alex: great. next steps: repro minimal failing loop, add unit test that simulates schedule crossing with shard joins, and add a small renormalize patch behind a feature flag. also run evals on our longcontext goldset to quantify quality delta.
Tim: I'll bench the latency impact of renorm on a representative kernel.
Eva: I'll draft an eval plan (perplexity + instruction fidelity + rollback thresholds) and schedule a canary rollout with automatic fallback to baseline if regressions > 3% on goldset.
Maria: thanks all, will open a PR with failing unit test + repro harness and link kv snapshots. ping me for access if needed. :raised_hands:
